title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Fantasy Orange
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kit Only Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Fantasy Orange Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This convenient replacement pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in a vibrant and zesty citrus profile. Fantasy Orange delivers the intense, juicy flavour of freshly squeezed Orange with a subtly sweet and tangy finish. It provides a bright and uplifting citrus experience that is exceptionally refreshing from the first sdun-soaked draw to the last. Each pod and refill pack is designed for the Dojo Blast 10K device, while also being fully compatible with the Vaporesso Dojo Blast 30K prefilled pod kit. Offering up to 10,000 puffs* per pack, it is powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour. *Puff count is an estimate and depends on the length of draw on each use.
